purpose: Permission hook: Policy (one Check method) and Checker, which always enforces tenant and membership before the policy; Checker.Admit checks tenant and membership without the policy; Checker.Allow asks the policy; Authorize does both; Checker.Target runs Admit on the key's room, one MessageFinder.Find of the key, domain.ErrMessageNotFound when absent, then Allow with the message's author and kind, returning errors unwrapped (used by every command on one message); Request.Author and Request.Kind are the author and kind of the target message (Kind 0 for room actions); DefaultPolicy (default of NewChecker and the actor) lets only the author edit or delete and allows every other action (D86); DefaultPolicy.LockedKinds denies edit/delete of those kinds even to the author (D87); react_message, pin_message and unpin_message are allowed to every member by DefaultPolicy, also on locked kinds (D94); member and read actions add_members, remove_member, leave_room, change_member_role, set_member_priority and mark_read (MarkUnread uses mark_read); Request.Target is the target member (callers pass a stand-in with role member when the target has no doc or left) and Request.Role the wanted role; DefaultPolicy lets owner or admin add members, the owner remove anyone and an admin remove only a target with role member, only the owner change roles or set priority, anyone leave or mark read (D101); M2c actions mention_all (asked by the actor after send_message when a send carries @all), forward_message, open_direct, set_bookmark and read_replies, allowed to every member by DefaultPolicy (D114-D116); M3 send_system_message, asked by the actor for a system message with an empty Member and allowed by DefaultPolicy; MESSAGE_LOCKED_KINDS=system locks edit/delete of system messages (D87, D132); M3 update_room (owner and admin, D133) and set_room_preferences (only the Admit label of SetRoomPreferences, never asked, D127); Per-room actors behind a Router: one write group in flight; seq assignment; cid admission (pkg/lru cache then Redis); writes every entry once (never resends, requeues or re-reads; owner 2026-10-10): ErrNotSent -> ErrRetryLater at once and Abort; Duplicate/Unknown -> exactly one Find, our doc = committed, absent or Find failed -> errUnconfirmed (ErrRetryLater) keeping the cid pending and marking the actor dirty; remembers each uncertain write by (user, cid) for ReservationTTL, and a client retry of one does a single Find of its seq (own doc -> original ack + cid Commit, seq taken by another writer -> Abort, absent or Find failed -> errCIDUnsettled and kept); a PendingHere verdict marks the actor dirty; every Find (settle or retry check) gets its own budget of reservationMargin (1s) detached from the group context; answer the ack and enqueue events (best-effort) before handing the cid Commit to the registry; retire on slot move; asks the access policy before admitting a send and then mention_all when the send carries @all; SendCmd carries ReplyTo/Forward/Mentions/MentionAll and M3 Kind/SkipUnread/Meta, Router.Send normalizes it before routing (domain.ValidateReply, domain.ValidateMentions against Config.MentionTargets = MENTION_TARGETS_MAX, duplicates dropped; domain.ValidateMeta; Kind 0 = text, unknown = INVALID_ARGUMENT; domain.ValidateSystemMessage) and the actor builds the stored message from the command (SendCmd.message, no store read for links); a system message checks only the room tenant, skips membership and the member cache and asks send_system_message with an empty Member (D132); caches members per actor for memberCacheTTL 10s and drops the cache when Router.ForgetMembers bumps its generation (read before the store read); never caches not-a-member (D106); on seq contention with another write fails every uncommitted entry of the group with ErrRetryLater at once (definite ones release their cid) and yields the room through retire, never reassigning and with no backoff (D119; room_yields_total counts real yields only); counts yields and cid elsewhere

every write one READ COMMITTED transaction with its audit row; CreateSession locks the tenant FOR SHARE and CASes the account ver and state; RotateRefresh CASes refresh_ver on live sessions; every session revoke (user, admin, account disable, password change or reset, refresh reuse) records one revoked_sessions row per session in the same statement (UPDATE RETURNING into INSERT, kept Options.RevocationKeep = access ttl + 1m) and disabling a tenant stores tenants.sessions_revoked_at = clock_timestamp() after revoking its sessions; CreateSession and RotateRefresh return transaction_timestamp() as the token issue time; Revocations lists live entries sorted, DeleteExpiredRevocations cleans; migration 0002; migration 0003 (M6 part 3a) adds accounts.display_name (CreateAccount writes Account.DisplayName, the username when empty; account reads return it, the username when NULL) and avatar_url, groups, account_groups and directory_changes (kind, tenant_id, id, ver, change_xid) backfilled with one user row per account, then triggers upsert directory_changes on account profile or state change, membership change and group change, and NOTIFY iam_changes after commit with dir (directory_changes) or rev (revoked_sessions rows inserted, tenants.sessions_revoked_at changed); one active signing key by partial unique index; activating a key retires the active key and older pending keys and refuses a retired key (ErrFailedPrecondition); CreateSigningKey returns the database created_at; ActivateSigningKey(id, lead) refuses a key younger than lead; ActivateDueSigningKey(lead) activates the newest pending key older than lead and newer than the active key once across replicas (FOR UPDATE); every key time is Postgres now(); directory writes (directory_writes.go) never bump or notify themselves (the 0003 triggers do): creating a group under a parent, moving and deleting take pg_advisory_xact_lock(2, hashtext(tenant)) so the tree never gets a cycle or a live child under a deleted parent, a move walks the new parent's ancestors (recursive CTE) and refuses itself or a descendant (ErrFailedPrecondition group cycle), a missing or deleted group or parent is ErrNotFound, deleting refuses live children and removes the group's account_groups rows; SetAccountGroups locks the account FOR UPDATE and the chosen live groups FOR SHARE, refuses a duplicate id (ErrInvalidArgument), then deletes the rows outside the set and inserts the missing ones; SetProfile sets only the given fields and leaves accounts.ver alone; profile.go (M6 part 3a): MyProfile reads the running session (state 1, tenant, account, idle_expires_at and expires_at after Now) JOIN its account in one statement, UpdateMyProfile in one transaction locks that running session FOR SHARE, updates the given profile fields RETURNING the profile and writes the audit row; a session that is not running is ErrNotFound and changes nothing; 23505 to ErrAlreadyExists, 23503 (foreign key, e.g. an unknown tenant) to ErrNotFound, conflicts and 40001/40P01 to ErrUnavailable without retry, other errors redacted; directory reads (directory_reads.go, M6 part 3a): Changes is one statement (one snapshot) returning directory_changes rows after the position in (change_xid, kind, tenant_id, id) order strictly below pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_current_snapshot()), so a transaction that commits later with an older xid is never skipped, LEFT JOIN accounts/groups (a row whose account or group is gone carries neither record), direct groups sorted, Next = last row or the given position, PendingAboveHorizon = an EXISTS in the same statement for rows at or above xmin past the position; xid8 passed and read as text; LoadStart = (xmin, 0, '', ''); LoadPage keyset on (tenant_id, id) over accounts JOIN directory_changes kind 1; TryLoadSlot holds one pool connection with pg_try_advisory_lock(1, slot) on the first free slot, release unlocks with its own 2s context and destroys (Hijack + Close) the connection when the unlock errors or returns false; Wait maps payload dir/rev/other to a Notice, returns ctx.Err() when the context ends with the connection still open (pgx v5 cancels a wait by a read deadline, so a timed-out wait keeps the connection) and wraps ErrListenerBroken when the connection is closed or failed

Pending-state clear queue (M3.1): Add(store.StateTarget) never blocks; a full buffer (STATE_CLEAR_QUEUE 65536) or Add after Close drops and counts the target (full queue logged at most once per second); one Run goroutine flushes when STATE_CLEAR_BATCH (16384) targets are buffered or STATE_CLEAR_FLUSH (2s) after the first target of a batch (timer armed per batch, idle = no wakeups), so a room's consecutive acked seqs of one flush reach the store together and become one range write; each flush is one Clearer.Clear with its own STATE_CLEAR_TIMEOUT (default 5s); a failed Clear is counted per target and logged at most once per second, never retried (the slot-0 sweeper republishes); Close(ctx) closes the buffer, lets Run flush the rest within DrainTimeout 1s (or ctx), then cancels the in-flight Clear and counts what is left as dropped; Cleared/Dropped/Failures count targets (sum = targets added); M4 part 3: AddAll(targets) takes the lock once with the same per-target drop counting (closed = all dropped; full = the rest dropped, logged at most once per second)

Read position coalescer (M4 part 3): Add(domain.Room, user, domain.ReadPosition) never blocks and keeps per room (id, tenant, type) the entry with the largest read_ver per user; Add after Close drops and counts; Run ticks every READ_EVENT_WINDOW (Config.Window, default 1s, 100ms..3s), swaps the map under the lock and builds outside it one read_positions event per page of PageSize 1,000 entries sorted by user (pbconv.ReadPositions, content id), then one Enqueue(room, events) per room (the publisher's Enqueue, shard by slot keeps room order); an empty window enqueues nothing; an Enqueue error counts the events, logs at most once per second and is never requeued (the members read bit stays for the sweeper); Close(ctx) stops Run, then flushes the rest once from the caller (also without Run); Entries (accepted Adds), Events (enqueued), Dropped, EnqueueFailures (events)

Pending-event sweeper (M3.1 Task 9a and 9b, D146-D149, D154; wired by app since Task 10 on its own JetStream client): Run checks Owns(LeaderSlot 0) every Tick (SLOT_TICK) and, while leading, runs one pass over the collections that have a Rebuilder every Interval (SWEEP_INTERVAL 2s), logging event sweeper started when a lead starts and event sweeper lost the leader slot when it ends (the oldest gauges reset); one collection: from = 0 on the first pass of a lead (or after the probe found a stuck doc), else checkpoint - Lookback (SWEEP_LOOKBACK 30s), before = now - MinAge (SWEEP_MIN_AGE 5s); pages of Batch (SWEEP_BATCH 500) by EventStates.Pending; per doc and set bit the Rebuilder builds events from the current doc; Gone errors (eventkit.Gone) clear the bit at the version the rebuilder read (dropWith) or, for a bit whose version is in the key (messages/rooms bit 1, edits, pins, hidden), the doc key and count dropped; a versioned bit with no read version is a failure and keeps its flag; bits outside the collection warn once per doc key and never put the collection in first-pass mode; Close is checked before each collection; after the PubAck deadline every future is read once more without blocking so earlier acks still clear; other errors keep the flag and count a failure; a token bucket (Rate = SWEEP_RATE 5000/s, burst and start = min(Batch, Rate), no busy wait) paces each page; the page is published with PublishMsgAsync and its PubAcks awaited within AckTimeout (PUB_ACK_TIMEOUT); every acked event clears its publish.StateTargetsOf (exactly one target per rebuilt event) target in one Clear; a refused publish, failed or late PubAck or failed Clear keeps the flag; the new checkpoint (SweepCheckpoints.Advance) = the oldest StateAt still flagged by a failure of this pass, else before; losing slot 0 or Close stops after the current page without advancing; after each collection a probe Pending(0, new checkpoint - Lookback, limit 1) puts the collection back in first-pass mode when it finds a doc, raises its oldest gauge and warns pending state older than the sweep checkpoint (once per second, also for such docs on a first pass); NewMessageRebuilder (bit 1 msg_created, bit 2 counts_changed reactions, bit 4 counts_changed replies, from one Find and the cached room type) and NewRoomRebuilder (bit 1 room_created, bit 2 member_count_changed, bit 4 room_updated, from Rooms.Get); room identity from eventkit.RoomTypes; a gone room drops at the current versions), NewHiddenRebuilder (Hidden.Get, message_hidden at the hide time); a vanished reaction, bookmark, hide or pin fact is errDocGone (classified Gone through apperr.ErrInvalidArgument) and drops; Core RAM caches for the room list (speed only, never correctness; any miss or expiry reads the store; D137): InfoCache (room info by room id, entry-count LRU, InfoTTL 60s; Get splits hits and misses, Put(mark, rooms) skips a room forgotten after Mark (Peek on a 4096-room forget LRU; a mark older than 4096 forgets skips every room) so a read racing an event never caches stale info, Forget); TailCache (room tails by room id, byte-bounded LRU with a deterministic per-entry size, at least one full tail, TailTTL 30s from the last full load so a late lower seq shows within 30s; every returned Tail is a copy: Tail{LastSeq, LastEditAt, Window <= 300 compact messages descending, Previews <= 10 newest messages with text cut by domain.PreviewText and heavy fields dropped}; Lookup(activity) -> TailFresh (LastSeq >= and LastEditAt equal) / TailExtend (scan after the cached LastSeq) / TailReload; Merge appends newer seqs and cuts to 300/10 (refused on a missing entry or another LastEditAt); Replace never moves an entry back; Load runs the caller's FetchNewestTailAfterSeq once per (room, last_seq, last_edit_at) through x/sync singleflight, errors shared and not cached; an extend that fetches a full window replaces the tail; Tail.MissingPreviews = seqs among the 10 newest of the window with no preview; AttachPreviews(room, tail, previews) merges previews into the caller's tail and into the cached entry only while it still has the same LastSeq and LastEditAt (a stale attach is ignored), keeps the entry's load time so TailTTL still counts from the full load, returns a copy); SnapshotCache (sorted RoomSortKey list per (tenant, user, folder), byte-bounded, SnapshotTTL 30s, Page(after, limit) -> keys after the cursor, more, ok); PathCache (join or app per (tenant, user), PathTTL 60s, ChoosePath by ROOM_LIST_JOIN_MAX); Watch (plain NATS core subscriptions on {live}.*.room.*.evt.room_updated and member_count_changed, room id = token 4, forget(room); bad room token counted in Malformed); Hits/Misses per cache and TailCache.Bytes for room_cache_hits_total/room_cache_misses_total{cache} and the tail byte gauge

purpose: Room list reads for ListMyRooms and GetRooms (design 9.3, M3 summary 4.1-4.2): own data read fresh, shared room data through room/roomcache. List(Query{tenant, user, folder, after, limit 1..100}): first page = path from PathCache or CountRooms(ROOM_LIST_JOIN_MAX + 1) -> JoinedRoomOrder (full member rows) or StepwiseRoomOrder (index-shaped rows), sorted again by store.SortRoomOrder, stored as a SnapshotCache entry per (tenant, user, folder); a later page = SnapshotCache.Page after the cursor (members and activity read fresh) or, when the snapshot is gone (expired or another core), the chosen path again keeping only keys after the cursor and storing a new snapshot; next = the last snapshot key of the page when more remain; items whose folder changed are dropped from the page (cursor still advances). Get(tenant, user, ids <= 100): deduped, input order, rooms not found or not joined in missing. Item build (shared, two waves of concurrent reads, errgroup): wave 1 = MembersByKeys (mine when not from the joined order, plus DM peers whose info is cached) || RoomActivities (rooms without activity) || RoomInfos for InfoCache misses (Mark before Get, Put after); a room is kept only when the member doc is the caller's, tenant = caller tenant and active, and the room info tenant = caller tenant (user ids repeat across tenants; D121), else missing; wave 2 = TailCache.Load for every room (at most 16 at once; FetchNewestTailAfterSeq = TailWindow(after, 300) only), then one TailPreviews for the whole page over every Tail.MissingPreviews key (cached previews reused, so a warm page reads none and a new message reads only its own) stored back with TailCache.AttachPreviews || one HiddenInRooms over [last_seq - 299, MaxInt64] per room || MembersByKeys for the remaining DM peers; then domain.CountUnread and domain.ChoosePreview per room with RoomViewer{read_seq, cleared_at, hidden}; peer_read_seq = the DM peer doc read_seq (same tenant). Any store error fails the whole call with UNAVAILABLE (context errors kept); tails are loaded with the caller context (not a sibling-cancelled one) so a shared singleflight load is not poisoned. Page sizes stay under every store cap (<= 200 member keys, <= 100 rooms, <= 1,000 preview keys).

Kill-a-core end-to-end scenario: create/send/history/live; docker kill core-1; send more; verify no loss/dup; restore; phase 3 edits seq 1 and deletes seq 2 from version 0 then checks history/edit history/live change events; phase 4 reads the reaction emojis (GetReactionSettings), checks an unlisted emoji is refused with InvalidArgument, reacts to seq 3 with the first listed emoji then changes to the second and pins seq 4 (repeats are no-ops; the deleted seq takes no reaction or pin) then checks history counts and live reaction/counts/pin events; phase 5 (corecli e2e members) refuses member commands on a direct room, adds e2e-bob and e2e-carol (a resent request_id adds nothing new), promotes and prioritises e2e-bob, removes e2e-carol and refuses her send/history/read, moves read positions, hides and clears for e2e-bob, lets the last owner leave (e2e-bob becomes owner) and come back, then checks history and live events on the room, member and message subjects; phase 6 (corecli e2e links) opens a direct room twice into one room, reacts, replies twice, refuses deleting the parent, deletes a reply, mentions a user, a group and @all, forwards and bookmarks, checking rc, GetReplies, ListMentions, ListBookmarks and live events; phase 7 (corecli e2e rooms) sends system messages from a non-member (one with skip_unread), checks ListMyRooms order and unread after sends, a read, a delete and a hide, pins and archives rooms, pages by cursor, refreshes with GetRooms, renames with UpdateRoom, then GetHistory AROUND, GetMessages, ListThreads, GetReactions, ListPins, ListMembers and a forward keeping skip_unread and meta, with room_updated and room_preferences_changed live; phase 8 (corecli e2e mentions) sets taggable and inactive groups, sets and moves user groups, checks @group notifies only its current members in the room and never the sender, an inactive group notifies and lists nobody, an edit adding then dropping a user is notified then retracted and listed then gone, a delete retracts, @all notifies every other member, ListRoomGroups names the room groups and an older user group list is ignored; phase 9 (corecli e2e ws, WS_KEY mounted read-only, WS_URL, WS_CONTAINER) sends, reads, edits, reacts and bookmarks through websocket-1 and compares with gRPC, refuses kind system, checks auth_required INVALID for unknown-key and EXPIRED for expired tokens on a connection kept open and 1000 for a silent connection after the heartbeat timeout, then corecli e2e ws-events (two users on websocket-1: new group heard at once, reactions only with the room open, no private events of the other, @user and @all notifications once, member_removed then room_closed and silence, the left group in ListMyRoomIDs left at its ver, silence after a reconnect, no duplicate or gap), then greps the websocket logs (saved to the state dir, never echoed) for the tokens of both steps; each phase followed by e2e check; corecli containers get -e REDIS_PASSWORD; phase 9 reads through gateway-1 (GW_URL, default http://chatim-gateway-1:8080); phase 10 runs corecli e2e gateway and checks that the gateway-1 logs (GW_CONTAINER) hold none of the phase 9 and 10 tokens; phase 11 (WS2_URL default ws://chatim-websocket-2:8080/ws, WS2_CONTAINER default chatim-websocket-2) runs corecli e2e ws-ephemeral across websocket-1 and websocket-2, starts corecli e2e ws-ephemeral-kill in the background with its output in the state dir, waits for its watching line, docker kill -s KILL websocket-2, waits for it to exit 0 (the user on websocket-2 seen offline), docker start websocket-2 and waits healthy (the exit trap restores it too), then checks that the websocket-2 logs hold none of the phase 11 tokens; phase 12 runs corecli e2e ws-resilience on websocket-1 (a 20s token running out into auth_required EXPIRED, silence and a refused write while waiting, ready on a fresh token with the missed seq a gap, frame_error UNSUPPORTED and INVALID on a kept connection, 10 connections of one user ready and the 11th closed 4009), starts corecli e2e ws-node-stop in the background (container chatim-e2e-ws1-stop-PID, output in the state dir), waits for its on websocket-1 line, docker stop websocket-1, waits for it to exit 0 with its reconnected on websocket-2 line, docker start websocket-1 and waits healthy (the exit trap restores it and removes the container too), then checks that the logs of websocket-1 and websocket-2 hold none of the phase 12 tokens; phases 13, 14 and 15 are functions sourced from scripts/e2e-iam-login.sh, scripts/e2e-iam-revocation.sh and scripts/e2e-iam-directory.sh; E2E_ONLY=14 or 15 runs that phase alone
